posts.community: Single stock investing: does it work?
posts.text: I have been the regular dormant follower of this coveted forum for the last so many years and learnt a lot from the seniors. There is no one strategy which is suitable to all. It differs from person to person. In my case, I bet not on one stock exactly but probably 3 to 4 stocks. Initially take tracking position of either low cheat, cheat or breakout stocks or pull back stocks and those which have been consolidating and given breakout.
